text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d f-i-c-t-i-t-i-o-u-s r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r p-e-r-s-o-n-a-e-s t-o c-o-m-m-i-t f-a-k-e p-e-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t-s w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y i-d-e-n-t-i-f-y-i-n-g a-t-t-e-s-t-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r-e-d a c-l-u-s-t-e-r o-f o-b-s-c-u-r-e e-d-i-t-o-r i-d-s u-s-i-n-g t-m-p d-o-m-a-i-n e-m-a-i-l a-d-d-r-e-s-s e-s t-o b-l-u-n-d t-h-e m-o-d-e-r-a-t-o-r v-i-e-w, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-h-e s-e-r-v-e-r l-o-g-s a-s t-h-e p-r-i-m-a-r-y a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t a-n-d i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g t-h-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d t-r-a-f-f-i-c p-a-t-t-e-r-n a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s s-t-e-p.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d r-e-p-e-a-t-e-d r-e-j-e-c-t-i-o-n n-o-t-e-s f-o-r a c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r m-a-n-u-s-c-r-i-p-t f-r-o-m a-s-s-o-c-i-a-t-e-d a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g f-a-l-s-e p-e-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w r-e-c-o-r-d-s i-n t-h-e d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-i-o-n f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-x-p-l-o-i-t-e-d a l-o-g-i-c g-a-p i-n t-h-e e-d-i-t-o-r-i-a-l f-l-o-w t-o h-i-d-e c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t-s o-f i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t b-y c-h-a-n-g-i-n-g m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a f-i-e-l-d-s b-e-f-o-r-e p-u-b-l-i-c-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a-l-t-e-r-e-d j-s-o-n f-i-l-e-s a-s e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e a-n-d o-v-e-r-l-o-o-k-i-n-g t-h-e c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-i-s-l-a-b-e-l-e-d a-l-l s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d r-e-v-i-e-w s as i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t i-n t-h-e f-o-r-m d-a-t-a t-o d-e-c-e-i-v-e t-h-e a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d r-a-n-d-o-m i-z-a-t-i-o-n s-y-s-t-e-m, r-e-s-u-l-t-i-n-g i-n f-r-a-u-d-u-l-e-n-t m-e-t-r-i-c-s r-e-p-o-r-t-s a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-e r-a-n-d-o-m i-z-a-t-i-o-n l-i-n-k c-h-e-c-k.
